biggest_catch: Panel App is a real, still-listed app, but the company does not publish concrete payout terms in any obtainable official source — no points-to-dollar rate appears in the official app description or findable terms — so it fails the verification checklist (same reason R0213 Nielsen was rejected).
catches: No official published points-to-dollar conversion exists; concrete rates (e.g., 1,000 points = $1 Amazon gift card; ~33 points/day passive for location sharing) come only from third-party reviewers.
Earnings are tiny: third parties estimate roughly $1/month of passive points for keeping the app installed with location on.
The app collects device data including apps and location for market research — you are paid in pennies for continuous location tracking.
Some guaranteed rewards were removed over time (PayPal redemption removed per third-party guides); current reward options are gift cards and sweepstakes entries.
Sweepstakes redemptions are chance-based with no guaranteed payout.

c1.evidence: Panel App by Placed is a real app — official App Store description (via listing mirrors): 'Panel App is a free mobile loyalty club... Earn points by taking location-based surveys and sharing your location. Use points towards great prizes, rewards, sweepstakes, gift cards, and more!' Company real, app still listed.

c2.evidence: No concrete payout terms published by the company in any obtainable official source: the official app description mentions points redeemable for gift cards/sweepstakes but states no points-to-dollar rate and no redemption threshold; figures like 1,000 pts = $1 appear only in third-party reviews.

c3.evidence: Official app description: free to participate ('free mobile loyalty club'); no fee stated.

c4.evidence: No official rewards/terms page with concrete payout terms obtained — the official panelist Terms of Service URL (placed.com/terms-of-service-panelist) was referenced in the app listing but its contents were not verifiable; the official app description contains no payout figures.

eligibility: Free to install; requires location services and device-data collection consent; age 17+ per the App Store listing.
notes: Rejected per the strict checklist: c2 and c4 fail. Panel App is real and still operating, but 'real and operating' is not enough — the checklist requires concrete company-published payout terms, which do not exist in any obtainable official source. Third-party reviewers consistently describe ~$1/month-level passive earnings, so even if terms were found, this would be a very-low-value route. Do not present as verified without an official published rate. Catalog headline '0' is directionally right (near-zero), but the route stays unverified.

s1.note: Eligibility (17+, location services required) comes from the App Store listing, not a company terms page.

s2.note: No fee to participate per the official app description.

s4.note: Not assessable — no official payout claims found to check for weasel words.

s5.note: placed.com/terms-of-service-panelist is the company's official ToS URL (referenced verbatim in the app listing), but its contents could not be verified this session.

s6.note: No officially documented steps with concrete rewards.

s7.note: Official app-description content obtained via listing mirrors 2026-09-22/23; no official terms page with payout figures obtainable.

timing: Unknown from official sources — no published payout schedule.
